first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and shortening onboarding has previously improved time-to-value and adoption without the retention risk associated with promotional pricing. Verify the onboarding and activation records before committing, then run a guarded test with activation, qualified revenue, and retention monitored.

final.rationale: Run a standard A/B test of a shortened onboarding flow. The current completion decline directly matches the problem addressed by memory_86, which showed higher completion, 2.1 fewer days to value, and a 3% retention lift. This is the strongest sustainable path to qualified revenue and avoids the known retention downside of promotional pricing. Monitor activation, qualified pipeline/revenue, time-to-value, and 30-day retention; activation messaging remains a plausible follow-up but cannot be run this week.
